WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.healtheval,
    sc.scancount,
    sc.gbsize,
    sc.spanmin
  FROM scans sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
status_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    SUM(scancount) as total_scancount,
    SUM(gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(spanmin), 0) as rate
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
rate_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate
  FROM status_aggregates
)
SELECT 
  sa.healtheval,
  sa.total_scancount,
  sa.rate,
  sa.rate - ra.avg_rate as rate_diff
FROM status_aggregates sa
CROSS JOIN rate_average ra
WHERE sa.rate > ra.avg_rate;
